title: Cracked-Censer Novice
text: A lost Choir novice swings a broken censer in uneven circles, broadcasting a hymn too weak to guide anyone home.
flavor: The song is wrong, but not yet cruel.

defeatReward.text: You still the cracked censer and mark its harmless frequency.

imagePrompt: A frail choir novice in smoke-stained robes holding a cracked brass censer with weak blue signal light, ruined chapel walkway, sympathetic but eerie
